description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Jamf develops Apple device management and security solutions. The Associate Software Engineer builds tools that help organizations succeed with Apple, collaborating with engineers and product leadership while learning and following engineering practices.
Associate Software Engineer building tools that help organizations succeed with Apple

Responsibilities:
• The Associate Software Engineer is responsible for building the tools required to help organizations succeed with Apple
• Collaborate with experienced Engineers, Product Management and leadership to understand priorities and how those solve problems
• Subject matter expert in various Jamf components and product offerings
• Collaborate with more experienced engineers when needed
• Efficiently use available tools with guidance
• Learn and follow engineering best practices and processes while being able to explain deviation
• Partner with senior engineers to understand technical concepts
• Maintain a positive attitude while working through challenges
• Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory
• Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches
• Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

Requirements:
• Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity
• Highschool Diploma / GED

Preferred:
• Minimum of 1 of experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of testing and quality assurance processes
• Experience in current programming language and tools based on position
• Experience with TypeScript, including building or maintaining production code
• Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda and other AWS services
• Working knowledge of Agile development practices, such as sprints, backlog grooming, and standups
• Experience developing with AI tools, such as building AI-enabled features or applications, not just using coding assistants
• 4 years / Bachelor's Degree
• A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered
